Build Safer, Faster, Cheaper

Introducing the world’s first AI-powered piling solution for utility-scale solar.

Scroll to Explore

Pile shakeout is a thing of the past. The RPD 35 can carry up to 224 piles and a maximum payload of 34,000 pounds.

Make complex foundations simple. Piles up to 19 feet long are supported, in cross sections from W6×7 to W8×28. 

Drive with precision. The RPS 25 guides piles to within 1.0° from plumb and 15 millimeters from design elevation.

Scale production and accelerate schedule. The robots operate in coordinated fleets up to 24 hours a day.

Build safer, faster, and cheaper with the RPD 35 and RPS 25 pile driving robots.
